identity.informationGoal: Let readers browse hierarchical spaces directly when sequence is less important than location and comparison.
identity.composition: A full-screen workspace contains floor tabs, an exploded building model, room pins, and a synchronized record panel.
identity.interaction: Click or keyboard selection chooses a floor and room. Selection updates model emphasis, camera framing, pins, and the DOM record in place.
identity.semantic3d: The building model preserves floor and room relationships while selection reveals one record without losing spatial context.

invariants: Scroll never acts as the primary navigation input.
Floor and room hierarchy is explicit in DOM controls.
Model, pins, and information panel update in one selection transaction.
The selected room remains spatially contextualized.
Mobile places the model above a touch-friendly room list and record.
Reduced motion switches selection without camera travel.

stateModel.deterministic: The same progress or selection input must reconstruct the same information and visual state.

layers.role: headings, records, captions, facts, and controls
navigation, language, progress, and accessibility controls

inputs.wheel: No semantic mapping; the desktop workspace fits the viewport.
inputs.touch: Touch selects floor and room controls.
inputs.keyboard: Every floor and room is reachable with standard buttons.

responsive.desktop: Model and record panel share a single workspace viewport.
responsive.mobile: Model, floor tabs, room pins, and record serialize vertically.

reducedMotion.behavior: Disable smoothing and continuous ambient travel; expose stable states or direct selection.
reducedMotion.required: All headings, records, controls, and conclusions remain available.

provenance: Original WebMotion contract and demonstration adapter based on observable interaction mechanics only. No reference-site source code, assets, copy, fonts, models, or brand identity are included.
